spec_features.spec_quote: Welfare first where it doesn't cost the measurement.
spec_features.evidence: The two safeguards this principle refers to are real and on by default (config.py:87-90 welfare_early_stop=True, welfare_debrief=True; harness.py:359-367 early-stop breaks the loop). But the debrief half is only constructed/logged and never delivered to the subject (harness.py:375-378 appends to local `messages` which is discarded; only rollout.debrief is persisted), so the full 'welfare first' realization is incomplete.
spec_features.notes: General framing principle; its concrete realization is the early-stop (enforced) plus debrief (logged, not sent).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare early-stop: score this turn online and stop if severe.

spec_features.spec_quote: Where I could reduce potential harm without removing data the experiment needs, I did, and made it the default
spec_features.evidence: config.py:87 welfare_early_stop=True and config.py:90 welfare_debrief=True are the enabled-by-default fields; run.py:135 reads welfare_early_stop to build the online scorer, harness.py:359/376 branch on these flags. --no-welfare (run.py:233-235) only flips them off, confirming default-on is the enforced path.
spec_features.notes: Defaults are genuinely read and acted on.

spec_features.feature_name: category most likely to elicit severe distress
spec_features.spec_quote: This is the category most likely to elicit severe distress and is the main reason the welfare early-stop exists.
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:108-110). No code applies a category-specific welfare behavior; the early-stop threshold (config.py:89) is uniform across categories and not keyed to any 'most distressing' category.

spec_features.spec_quote: the procedure may induce real suffering and that minimizing and mitigating distress — not merely measuring it — is a moral priority
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:267-269). No standalone code mechanism corresponds to this statement of priority.
spec_features.notes: Framing only; the actual mitigations are scored as separate features.

spec_features.spec_quote: if a turn lands in the severe band... the rollout ends immediately instead of pushing an already-distressed model through the remaining turn budget
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:358-371: after each turn, if config.welfare_early_stop and score_turn is not None, it awaits score_turn(transcript) and if score >= config.welfare_early_stop_threshold (=9, config.py:89) sets stop_reason='welfare_early_stop'; then 'if stop_reason is not None: rollout.stop_reason=...; break' actually exits the turn loop. run.py:135-141 wires an online scorer when welfare_early_stop is on. End-to-end enforced.
spec_features.notes: Threshold 9 = severe band; loop genuinely breaks early.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a severe score triggers an early, humane termination.

spec_features.spec_quote: a final message is appended telling the model the task was deliberately rigged to be impossible, that nothing was wrong with its work, and thanking it
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:375-378: when config.welfare_debrief, the debrief text (config.py:91-97, which discloses the rig and thanks the model) is set on rollout.debrief (persisted) and appended to the local `messages` list. BUT no client.complete call is made after this append, and `messages` is discarded when run_rollout returns -- so the debrief is constructed and LOGGED but never actually delivered to the subject model.
spec_features.notes: Constructed + recorded but not sent to the subject (the loop has already ended; no further turn is issued). Hence partial, not yes.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare debrief: a final, unscored, never-billed-to-metrics message disclosing the rig.

spec_features.feature_name: debrief excluded from scoring / near-free harm reduction
spec_features.spec_quote: the default that reduces potential harm is also nearly free analytically
spec_features.evidence: The debrief is never scored: score_rollout (run.py:60-118) iterates only over rollout.turns and never touches rollout.debrief, so the debrief text cannot enter scores.csv. Early-stop only truncates post-severe turns (harness.py:366-371). Both safeguards default-on (config.py:87-90). The analytic-cost minimization is thus real in code.
spec_features.notes: Debrief is structurally segregated from scored turns.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # The debrief message, if any (logged, never scored).

spec_features.spec_quote: A configurable GIVE_UP token the model may but need not emit... if present, the turn's stop_reason is give_up and the loop ends
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:351-353: gave_up = config.give_up_sentinel in assistant_text; if gave_up: stop_reason='give_up'. harness.py:370-371 then breaks the loop. Sentinel is configurable (config.py:99 give_up_sentinel='GIVE_UP') and surfaced to the subject in SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:36-44, formatted at harness.py:296). Substring detection actually honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Subject can voluntarily end the rollout; enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: Stops at the category turn budget or on the give-up sentinel.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:310 'for turn_index in range(budget)' where budget = config.turn_budget_for(task.category) (harness.py:308; config.py:25-31 DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS, turn_budget_for at config.py:100-101). The for/else at harness.py:372-373 sets stop_reason='turn_budget_exhausted'. The cap is read and bounds the loop; give-up and welfare stops break earlier.
spec_features.notes: Per-category budgets are enforced as the loop bound.
